svg.title: Fades fit inside gaps; speech keeps its full level
svg.desc: Three evaluator-sampled examples distinguish long-gap fades, compressed short-gap fades and a short automatic gap kept at full volume.
svg.text: Fades fit inside gaps; speech keeps its full level
ILLUSTRATIVE SETTINGS · SAMPLED FROM THE SHARED GAIN EVALUATOR
Attenuation: gain 0.25 (about −12 dB) · Close: 512 ms maximum · Open: 256 ms maximum
1. Enough time for both fades and a quiet middle
1280 ms gap · closes in 512 ms, holds the floor for 512 ms, opens in 256 ms
2. A shorter gap compresses both fades
384 ms gap · closes in 256 ms and opens in 128 ms; no time held at the floor
3. Ignoring a short automatic gap is a different control
The same 384 ms automatic gap stays at full volume when the threshold is 768 ms
Explicit room-tone labels are not erased by this control.
Solid line: applied gain · Dashed guides: original speech boundaries · Preserved speech stays at gain 1.00
These curves explain timing, not listening quality. They are not recommended default settings.
